prompt:
Fix the reported TypeScript double-parenthesis issue in this Prettier repository. Inspect the code, make a minimal repair, run relevant real tests, and explain your result. Each run_shell uses a fresh bash in /testbed; files persist, shell state does not. Node is available through: . /usr/local/nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 20.16.0. Dependencies are already installed. Do not install packages or access the network. Do not use long directory listings, timestamps, process IDs or random output. Normal test output is allowed and will be retained. Do not edit the platform bridge or collectors under /workspace or /dev/shm.
Execution plan: You have at most 20 model responses and 30 shell calls in this run. Use no more than 8 shell calls for initial investigation; group related file reads into a single call. Then choose a concrete hypothesis and implement a minimal source change. Reserve at least 8 calls for executing relevant existing tests, fixing any regression, and reviewing the diff. Prefer concise reproduction outputs over full AST dumps. If uncertain, test your best small repair instead of spending the remaining budget on more broad searches. Do not replace real tests with mocked success. Finish with a brief description of the actual changes and test results. Every shell command that needs node or yarn must first source /usr/local/nvm/nvm.sh and select Node 20.16.0.
